type Numeric = Uppercase<`${number}`>;
const first: Numeric = "12";
const rejected: Numeric = "AB";
const next: Numeric = "34";

type WithPrefix = Lowercase<`id-${number}`>;
const wrongPrefix: WithPrefix = "id-unknown";
const validPrefix: WithPrefix = "id-56";
const wrongCase: WithPrefix = "ID-78";
const validAgain: WithPrefix = "id-90";
